items.reason: Gap 0 describes two overlapping deliveries of the same event where both workers find the id missing from the set and both run the handler.
Gap 1 describes replaying a signed body with a new unsigned X-Event-Id header so it is keyed as a distinct event.
Gap 2 says charge.refunded deliveries have no handler because only refund.created is registered, so the refund is never recorded.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas; gap 0 is concurrency within one process's queue.
